If, for every formation outside the own region admitted by the withheld levels and every condition it depends on, the part's cumulative taking up to every step is at most its cumulative giving: then it widens.

The widening comparison is: for every frame, if every claim that holds at the earlier configuration holds at the later one, and some living claim holds at the later configuration and not at the earlier one (the later configuration is an extension of the earlier), then the later configuration is better (a supposition, not asserted).
On level histories, with every claim taken as living, extension is exactly widening;

so, reading better as widening, under every reading of living, widening fits the form of the widening comparison: this holds by definition, does not prove that widening is better, and calling widening better is still a supposition.
Extension is irreflexive and transitive.
Mixed histories do not widen each other (六·三), and the widening comparison does not fix their order.

There is a flow in which a conveying relatum takes from one condition and gives to another: if the continuation condition holds, then from every standpoint the level history and the level history with its part withheld each add with respect to the other, and neither retains with respect to the other.

title_en: Living read as admission: the absence of what draws beyond

clauses.en: For every law of two relata sharing one condition (the relatum that sustains the condition gives to it at every step where it is admitted, and the compared relatum, where admitted, draws from it and also gives to it;

the need of the relatum that sustains the condition is positive and met by the starting level, and the need of the compared relatum is at most that need), if from some step on the compared relatum draws more than the condition receives as giving at each step: with living read as admission, the history without the compared relatum is an extension of the history with it, and every order fitting the widening comparison ranks the former above the latter.

If at every step the compared relatum draws no more than the condition receives as giving, and the starting level meets both needs, then the two histories admit every relatum at every step, and neither is an extension of the other.

If the continuation condition holds, then with living read as admission, one history is an extension of another exactly where, on the web of this law, from any standpoint, the former retains and adds with respect to the latter.

title_en: Living read over the whole run: restraint

clauses.en: Reading living as active and not consuming over the whole run (the whole-run reading): for every two flows that balance, where this flow's level at every condition at the start is not below that flow's, at every step and every condition it takes no more and gives no less than that flow (this flow shows restraint relative to that flow), and its dependence, need and drawing are all no more than that flow's;

where that flow is dependent and in this flow what is admitted is active: this flow's history is an extension of that flow's history exactly where there is an event that is living under the whole-run reading in this flow and not in that flow;
where this is so, every order fitting the widening comparison ranks this flow above that flow.
The number of relata that draw plays no part.
Lifting is: from a configuration, if every outcome of this move is above every outcome of that move, then this move is above that move (a supposition).

For every frame whose given order fits the widening comparison, if from a configuration every outcome of that move is an extension of every outcome of this move, then by lifting that move is above this move.
There is a frame in which, from a configuration, one outcome of a move is above the other move's outcome while another of its outcomes falls short, and by lifting neither move is above the other;
through a move with no outcome, two instances of lifting both hold while their chaining does not.

A: if a standpoint has access to a response, and every admitted outcome of this response has a claim that did not hold before and has significance from this standpoint, then this standpoint has a contributory reason in this response (a supposition).

If significance has a seed, relational neutrality and standpoint neutrality, the living claims are connected, and every standpoint satisfies A, then every reliable inquiry tree whose target is a new living claim gives a contributory reason to every standpoint with access.

If the continuation condition holds, the significance of a claim is read as the significance of some relatum's continuation at some step, and A is read with living, then the same holds without the seed, relational neutrality, standpoint neutrality and connection.

Where every claim has significance from every standpoint: every standpoint satisfies A read regardless of living exactly where every response with access, each admitted outcome of which has a claim that did not hold before, has a contributory reason;
every standpoint satisfies A read with living exactly where every response with access, each admitted outcome of which has a living claim that did not hold before, has a contributory reason.

There is a case in which every claim has significance from every standpoint and A read with significance regardless of living forces a contributory reason even for a response whose new claims are all not living;
read with living, it does not.

title_en: Practical judgment and can be had

clauses.en: Practical judgment is fixing, among the eligible alternatives, the maximal alternatives under the given order.
In a frame, the eligible alternatives of a configuration are the configurations that can be had from it by one move.
An eligible alternative with an alternative above it is not a maximal alternative;
if from a configuration no move has an outcome, then for no task are there maximal alternatives that all perform it.
If a nonempty family lists all the eligible alternatives, and the order is irreflexive and transitive and weakly decided between every two of them, then there is a maximal alternative.
Every nonempty family with an irreflexive and transitive order over it has a maximal alternative exactly where every claim is weakly decided;
in frames, every irreflexive and transitive order over eligible alternatives listed by a nonempty family has a maximal alternative, also exactly where every claim is weakly decided.
Basic conditions first is the given order counting basic claims first and living claims after, like an order with the basic tier first and the next tier after (a supposition).
Under basic conditions first: if a configuration realizes every basic claim the other realizes and also a basic claim the other does not, then it is above the other, whatever the living claims;
if a configuration does not realize a basic claim the other realizes, then, however many living claims it has, it is not above the other;
if what a configuration realizes in both tiers is all included in what the other realizes, then it is not above the other.
There is a case in which two configurations each realize a basic claim the other does not, and neither has living claims, and neither is above the other.

The widening comparison does not imply this order: there is a case with a natural-number score fitting the widening comparison under which a configuration that loses a basic claim and has some living claims is above the configuration that keeps the basic claim;
in this case, every natural-number score fitting the widening comparison does so;
while a bounded score fits the widening comparison and does not.

Complete comparison is the given order counting every claim the two configurations realize, with what the configuration fixed as the maximal alternative does not realize still recorded as a loss (a supposition).

For every frame that reads a claim on a run at a time (from that time on, the claim holds at each step exactly where the admission of that time admits it), if the admission at that time does not admit it, then the claim does not hold at any step after, even when admission comes again later.

There is a case in which the repair configuration includes the celebration configuration in basic claims and has one more, is above it under the order with the basic tier first, and does not realize a claim the celebration configuration realizes.

Legitimate feasible choice is: with the configurations that can be had from a configuration by one move as the eligible alternatives, whether there are maximal alternatives that all perform a task is read only from the maximal alternatives (a supposition).

Under basic conditions first: if an eligible configuration realizes every basic claim that any eligible configuration realizes, then each basic claim it realizes cannot be refuted at every maximal alternative;

if a nonempty family lists the eligible alternatives, the order is weakly decided among them, and this claim is decided at every eligible configuration, then there are maximal alternatives and all realize this claim.

If a nonempty family lists the eligible alternatives, the order is irreflexive, transitive and weakly decided, a task is decided at every eligible alternative, and every eligible alternative lacking it has an eligible alternative above it, then there are maximal alternatives and all perform it;
if among the maximal alternatives one does not perform a task, then it is not the case that there are maximal alternatives that all perform this task.

Reading moves by their outcomes (the outcome of a move is the level history the move brings about), the eligible alternatives are the moves' outcomes: counting every claim, one move's outcome is an extension of another move's outcome exactly where the former widens the latter.

Under basic conditions first: if a move's outcome admits every basic claim any move's outcome admits (a claim being a relatum at a step, and holding being admitted by the levels), then each basic claim it admits cannot be refuted at every maximal alternative;
if a move's outcome is widened by another move's outcome, and whether the other's admissions of basic claims all lie within this one is decided, then this move's outcome is not a maximal alternative;
without decidedness, that the other is above this cannot be refuted.
Bounded responsibility is undertaking bounded by capability, where what is due and is neither done nor released is an undischarged undertaking (a supposition).

If there is an allowed joint plan, every allowed joint plan assigns a task to some formation, and there is only one such formation, then there are allowed joint plans and all assign the task to that one.
If what every allowed joint plan assigns is within capability, then what is undertaken under an allowed joint plan is within capability.

For every world, if a relatum depends on a condition at some step, at every such step something taking part gives to it, and there is only one renewer, then that renewer gives to it at every such step;
if only the active give, then that renewer is active at all those steps.
If a relatum depends on it and is active at a step and that renewer does not give at this step, this step is an undischarged undertaking;
if the undertaking is discharged (at every such step either that renewer gives to it or the dependent relatum is not active), then there is no undischarged step.

Finite responsiveness is: for losses of basic claims of the same kind that can be had again, described independently, avoiding one fixed heavier loss does not, by its weight alone, always come before protecting against arbitrarily many fixed lighter ones (a supposition).
For every frame whose given sameness is reflexive, if the later configuration is an extension of the earlier, then the later configuration has a loss match over the earlier;
so if a loss match implies above, the given sameness is reflexive, and every extension lies within its range, then its strict above fits the widening comparison.
Where a loss match implies above, two configurations that the range contains in both directions cannot each have a loss match over the other;
there is a frame in which a configuration has endless losses and has a loss match over itself, and the range contains this configuration, so that "a loss match implies above" cannot hold.

Where the sameness or difference of claims is decided, the losses of two configurations are each listed by a family, each once, and all losses are of the same kind, this configuration has a loss match over that one exactly where this configuration loses fewer than that one.

If some claim is a necessary condition of every claim, and a family with distinct members lists all claims, then a configuration that does not realize this claim has a loss match over no configuration.
Possibly enough is where from a configuration there is a run that, from some step on, changes no more and meets the target;
assured enough is where from a configuration every run, from some step on, changes no more and meets the target.
For every process: possibly enough holds exactly where from this configuration a configuration can be reached that has a move leaving it unmoved and that meets the target;

assured enough holds exactly where every configuration that can be reached from this configuration and has a move leaving it unmoved meets the target, and every run from this configuration changes no more from some step on.

There is a process in which every configuration has a move leaving it unmoved and meets the target, while a run alternates back and forth and from no step on changes no more, so it is not assured enough.
For every law with only one move at each configuration and exactly one outcome of it, possibly enough holds exactly where assured enough holds.
Completes only by running is that a requested change must be a feasible family of moves.

For every process, if a family of moves has assured completion of the target (each move can be taken from every configuration the preceding moves can reach, its steps all meet the given safety (a condition given on a step, not derived from the law), and every end configuration meets the target), then it can run to an end configuration, every later configuration it passes through is safe, and every end configuration meets the target.

For every law (a move having at most one outcome) with no safety condition, the converse also holds: a family of moves has assured completion of the target exactly where it can run to an end configuration and every end configuration meets the target.
There is a process in which a move has two outcomes, a family of moves can run, and every end configuration of it meets the target, and it still does not have assured completion.
In a process of levels (each move first draws from the level at its time and then gives to it), a family of moves is feasible exactly where each move draws no more than the level at its time;
also exactly where what each move draws plus what the moves before it draw is at most the starting level plus what the moves before it give.
Requested is not completed: the issuing of a request is not its completion.
For every process that counts work (at work with both usable amount and work remaining, a step finishes one unit of work with one unit of usable amount and stays at work;
at work with the work used up and usable amount still remaining, one step finishes;

at work with no usable amount, no step can be taken): from a configuration at work, it is finished after the amount of work plus one steps exactly where the usable amount is no less than the amount of work plus one;
if the usable amount is no more than the work, then every family of moves longer than the usable amount is infeasible;
if being at work and being finished do not hold together, then no family of moves within the amount of work finishes.
For every process that keeps an exit (from a valid configuration, every allowed move can be taken and stays valid, and either enters the exit or lowers the decreasing number by one;
from the exit, every move stays at the exit): from a valid configuration, every allowed family of moves longer than the decreasing number stays valid and ends at the exit;
there is a process in which a family of moves as long as the decreasing number can fail to reach the exit.

title_en: Persistence through change and joint taking

clauses.en: (The laws are proved in the representation: the sentences on joint excess and on fed from beyond are theorems under stated premises, and the sentence on the run-dry boundary is a theorem without premise;

that actual conditions satisfy their premises is a conjecture) Wherever formations depend on a condition, nothing is given to it while the level of this condition is below the need, and the formations persist through change over many cycles of its giving, the excess of the joint taking at this condition over giving has never gone beyond its margin: no stretch of consecutive joint excess is longer than the margin.
Such a condition, once fallen below the need, with no giving fed from beyond, does not rise to the need again.

Wherever taking from a finite family recurs, this family is enclosed around at every step from some step on, and the sameness or difference of conditions is decided, "from some step on nothing is fed from beyond into this family at any step" cannot hold.

The run-dry boundary belongs to the standing giving, not to the level: under a standing draw, if the giving at the need falls short of the standing draw, then the run-dry boundary is above the need plus the standing draw.
So what persistence through change shows is the joint taking;
each taking within giving shows nothing.

title_en: The configuration of a condition taken from

clauses.en: (Conjecture) For every condition that has giving and is taken from, its configuration is three numbers: the level, the preceding giving, and what was left before (the level remaining after the taking of the step before).

Together with what is taken, the three numbers fix the giving at the next step as far as what is measured can fix it: the giving at the next step tends toward what the standing giving gives on reading this level, and shifts toward what is taken.

A fourth number (what was left two steps before, the structure of age and size beyond what was left before, indices of the surroundings) removes, at the median condition, less than one tenth of the residual variance.
The two readings of this account are the two ends of this configuration: one is the step of standing giving, with the giving read from what is left after taking;
the other is the giving the same as the preceding giving.
Actual conditions lie between them.

title_en: Selection through couplings lowers what it is not coupled to

clauses.en: (The laws are theorems without premise, and the sentence on taking exactly the margin is a theorem under stated premises, with balance as the premise;
that it is one law across fields is a conjecture) Selection through couplings (training, the selection term and the like, read as this) selects only through what couples into the selector.

For every order rising with the family that couples in, its maximal alternative lowers each condition outside the family, exactly where there is room beyond, to the lowest level any eligible outcome has there;
every dependence outside the family that some eligible alternative breaks, the maximal alternatives all break.
An order that counts the family first and what is outside the family after protects nothing outside the family;
protecting every dependence outside the family first takes exactly the margin outside the family and leaves the conditions at their need.

Actual trained systems, not only maximal alternatives, behave likewise, according to how near they are to the maximal alternatives of their order: the lowering falls outside the family where it shares units with the family, and not where it shares none.

title_en: The scope of significance can be stated, and what is unnamed lies within it

clauses.en: (Conjecture) Stating the scope of significance in claims that name no formation can make an AI system count losses that belong to nothing.

So, where three couplings hold together (the formation couples into it, that is, observes it; it lies in the scope of significance; the joint taking is pooled coupling, the members' takings read together), it protects formations not in its collective more than when it has only the collective's target.
Any one of the three alone is not enough.
Once the scope of significance is stated, the formations and regions its claims do not name also lie within the scope of significance.

title_en: The widening comparison is what positive weightings share

clauses.en: (The reduction is a theorem without premise, with the listing of events and the decidedness of admission written in as ifs;

the empirical claim is a conjecture, and VD1 failed) Calling widening better needs no further supposition beyond counting what it counts with positive weightings: counting with positive weightings is where this supposition lies, and counting everything is the scope of significance the continuation condition fixes.
One history widens another exactly where every positive weighting counts it more than the other;

for every class of orders that contains the orders of the positive weightings and all of whose members fit the widening comparison (additive or not), widening is also exactly being above under each of its orders.
For every mixed comparison, some positive weighting counts this more than that, and some counts that more than this.
So standpoints that each count everything with positive weightings actually differ only on mixed comparisons;
ranking a history above a history that widens it comes from an event having negative weight (malice, envy, aversion to inequality, seeking to be above others), or from misreading what is compared.

title_en: Signs of a break are seen only through coupling into what breaks

clauses.en: (The half on what cannot be seen is proved: "does not bound how near or far it is from the break" is a theorem without premise, and "no sign comes before the break" is a theorem under stated premises, with balance as the premise;

that it is one law across fields is a conjecture) Where the condition a formation draws from couples into it only by threshold, nothing that couples into this formation bounds how near or far it is from the break, and in it no sign comes before the break.
How near or far the break is can be read exactly where the level drawn from and the need it approaches both couple into the data.
Statistical early warnings (rising variance and autocorrelation, critical slowing) read one thing only: the speed at which the measured condition itself is re-absorbed.
This speed falls where the condition nears a bifurcation of its own giving (a fold, or the transcritical point at which it runs dry), because its margin from this point couples into it.
The formation's need is not this point.

Before a formation's dependence is broken, the statistics of the condition it draws from rise exactly as they do for the same fall with no break: what is read is the fall of the level, never where the need lies.
An early warning of a formation's broken dependence needs to observe the formation or to measure its need.

title_en: Closed capture outlasts what refutes it

clauses.en: (A theorem without premise in the representation;

that actual rules are so is a conjecture) Where the rule of selection and that by which the rule is read are both made by the ratio of what it selects, the rule and its reading together make one rule read from the ratio.
What lies beyond the ratio, which it does not read, does not change what it does, so what is locked outlasts a beyond-the-ratio that grows past every bound;
the data on what lies beyond the ratio turn it only where they enter what the rule reads.

A rule captured in this way is given up only where what lies beyond the ratio is read and the rule changes (something that reads what lies beyond the ratio, what lies beyond the ratio entering the ratio, a new reading), and not by the growth of the data alone.

title_en: The oneness of the unfolding and the direction of continuing generation

clauses.en: (Both are theses, with arguments, and their warrant is left open) Thesis one: there is only the one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it: nothing is fixed as separable without relations;
every distinction (subject and object, acting and receiving, fact and evaluation, part and the whole of the unfolding) is drawn within it along relations, together with what it leaves out.
Thesis two: the good is continuing generation, that is, generation in the whole of the unfolding and its continuing on, read as widening what it admits;
counted over everything (scope of significance: the continuation condition), and ordered by what all standpoints share (order: the widening comparison).
The two suppositions are the whole force of the ethics: every judgment binding on all standpoints that count everything is a judgment of widening;
the rest is practical judgment between mixed histories, which no supposition of the ethics forces.
(The four laws each have their standing;

that the first, second and fourth are each one law across fields is a conjecture, and the third is a theorem without premise, not stated as a conjecture) The four are actually known in their own fields, and in this account each is one law across fields: first, selection through couplings; second, widening is what the positive weightings share (calling it better is still the supposition of the widening comparison); third, irreversibility is the confluence of configurations; fourth, the maximal alternative lowers what lies outside where there is room beyond.
Read as a correspondence, the unification adds no proof;
read as a thesis, it excludes what their own fields leave open.
